title: Higher Up

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: You come here for a higher view?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You come here for a higher view?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Hmm. Suppose you're right. How'd you learn about stuff like that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm. Suppose you're right. How'd you learn about stuff like that?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: I'm here for so many reasons. Dreams. Crises. Existential existences. You should know that by now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm here for so many reasons. Dreams. Crises. Existential existences. You should know that by now.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: It's all good. Business is good. Existence is good. Dreams are vivid and life-altering. But I'm on something new now. Something intense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's all good. Business is good. Existence is good. Dreams are vivid and life-altering. But I'm on something new now. Something intense.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Interesting. How would you like to learn a different way. A more efficient, exponential way. I'm talking about something lay people normally wouldn't have.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting. How would you like to learn a different way. A more efficient, exponential way. I'm talking about something lay people normally wouldn't have.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: "Level Up!" - be shocked if you hadn't heard of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Level Up!" - be shocked if you hadn't heard of it.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: See that's why you need something like "Level Up!". Give yourself the experience to answer questions with purpose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See that's why you need something like "Level Up!". Give yourself the experience to answer questions with purpose.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Haven't we all. But what I have is better than a game. Dare I say, it's better than CameoPOV? And that dreamscape tech is my child. Mine alone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haven't we all. But what I have is better than a game. Dare I say, it's better than CameoPOV? And that dreamscape tech is my child. Mine alone.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: It's that intrigue, coupled with "Level Up!", that will bring you places. What do you want to learn?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's that intrigue, coupled with "Level Up!", that will bring you places. What do you want to learn?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Head of sales. District director. Ad-vo-cate. This is life changing stuff. You see that blue Spire over there? The one stretching toward Luna herself?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Head of sales. District director. Ad-vo-cate. This is life changing stuff. You see that blue Spire over there? The one stretching toward Luna herself?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Can only reach that high because of "Level Up!". The flash degrees? Lifetime illumination pills? You've seen the ads, arrows and data flashes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can only reach that high because of "Level Up!". The flash degrees? Lifetime illumination pills? You've seen the ads, arrows and data flashes.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: It's like putting a data file beneath your pillow and waking up with it infused into your head.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's like putting a data file beneath your pillow and waking up with it infused into your head.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Kind of. You wake up and you know you've experienced something. You're not exactly sure how you know it, but you know it. The experience lives with you afterward, it's yours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kind of. You wake up and you know you've experienced something. You're not exactly sure how you know it, but you know it. The experience lives with you afterward, it's yours.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Here. Just holding it in your hands will give off a feeling, go from there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here. Just holding it in your hands will give off a feeling, go from there.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: It knows what you want to dream about and goes from there. Like if you dream of a light house, you would wake up with a lifetime of experience as a keeper. You'd know it as well as you know your own birthday.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It knows what you want to dream about and goes from there. Like if you dream of a light house, you would wake up with a lifetime of experience as a keeper. You'd know it as well as you know your own birthday.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Don't take my word for it, ask anyone who's ever needed to know something immediately.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't take my word for it, ask anyone who's ever needed to know something immediately.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Go talk to Remo. Half his students use the stuff. And if that doesn't convince you, pay Malt a visit, though he'll probably be less enthused to speak with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go talk to Remo. Half his students use the stuff. And if that doesn't convince you, pay Malt a visit, though he'll probably be less enthused to speak with you.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: It's called making demand. Seriously, talk to them, the buildup is half the fun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's called making demand. Seriously, talk to them, the buildup is half the fun.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Think of the people who can't afford attorneys and are caught up in 'Sec center. Ask anyone in a college or university. That's what you should do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Think of the people who can't afford attorneys and are caught up in 'Sec center. Ask anyone in a college or university. That's what you should do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that why you're here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that why you're here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Kind of a loaded question when you're standing next to those plants.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kind of a loaded question when you're standing next to those plants.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Kind of a loaded question when you're standing next to those plants.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Kind of a loaded question when you're standing next to those plants.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, about all that stuff that went down...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, about all that stuff that went down...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, about all that stuff that went down...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, about all that stuff that went down...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How is the dream business?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How is the dream business?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What would that be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would that be?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like to read.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like to read.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I watch the feeds.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I watch the feeds.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Pick it up on the street.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pick it up on the street.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Pick it up on the street.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Pick it up on the street.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I pay attention to CorpSec PSAs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I pay attention to CorpSec PSAs.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I pay attention to CorpSec PSAs.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I pay attention to CorpSec PSAs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've played games.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've played games.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's your role in it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's your role in it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Color me intrigued.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Color me intrigued.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How does it work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How does it work?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They all stretch that high.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They all stretch that high.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I would wake up in another life?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would wake up in another life?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I would wake up in another life?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I would wake up in another life?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can experience anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can experience anything?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm down to try it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm down to try it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No thank you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do I know what I'm going to get?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do I know what I'm going to get?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How do I know what I'm going to get?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How do I know what I'm going to get?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Damn.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: People do this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People do this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This is my lucky day!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is my lucky day!
